info.title: settlement-anomaly
info.description: Extracted by reading FastAPI decorators directly (tier 4). Version from FastAPI(title=..., version="1.4.0") in app/main.py. Detection-only service: it writes SETTLEMENT_ANOMALY rows and nothing else. README: '후속 조치 프로세스는 본 서비스 범위 밖이다.' (the follow-up remediation process is out of scope).

post.description: Joins SETTLEMENT_DTL + SETTLEMENT_RUN + ORDER_MST for the given 정산일자, runs AnomalyDetector.detect, and inserts each hit into SETTLEMENT_ANOMALY with STATUS='DETECTED'. README says it is triggered after the settlement batch, daily at 03:00 — but no scheduler exists in this repo; the trigger is external and unverified.
